program.title: Section 232 — semiconductors and derivative products
program.detail: 25% additional only when the article is classifiable in 8471.50 / 8471.80 / 8473.30 AND meets U.S. note 39(b) TPP + DRAM bandwidth bands (logic IC). All other listed headings are 0% use/exclusion codes. Duty path is claim-gated (flags.s232_semiconductor).

source: CSMS #67400472 — GUIDANCE: Section 232 Import Duties on Semiconductors and their Derivative Products
technical_parameters: Logic integrated circuit, or article containing one, with (1) TPP > 14,000 and < 17,500 and total DRAM bandwidth > 4,500 GB/s and < 5,000 GB/s; or (2) TPP > 20,800 and < 21,100 and total DRAM bandwidth > 5,800 GB/s and < 6,200 GB/s.

headings.label: 232 semiconductors — on HTS list, params not met
232 semiconductors — U.S. data center (>100 MW AI load)
232 semiconductors — repair or replacement in the U.S.
232 semiconductors — U.S. startup / emerging growth company
232 semiconductors — non-data-center consumer electronics in the U.S.
232 semiconductors — non-data-center civil industrial use in the U.S.

notes: 8471 is also on the Proclamation 10908 auto-parts annex. Semiconductor claim (9903.79.01) wins over auto-parts for 8471.50 / 8471.80 when asserted.
Properly filed 9903.79.01 is not subject to 232 autos, MHDV, metals, or IEEPA reciprocal additional duties (CSMS #67400472).
Do not auto-assess 25% from HTS alone — TPP / DRAM bandwidth cannot be inferred from classification.
